# Version 4.157.0 (Unreleased)
> **Filtered glyph hardening**

## Highlights

Upcoming native fixes correct mask-filtered glyphs when reloading changes their outline, format or bounds.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Glyph reloads no longer reuse stale outline state** — Mask filtering rasterizes the reloaded glyph's own path, clears incompatible or non-overlapping masks, and preserves full plane strides for clipped embossed glyphs. This avoids stale outlines, sub-byte buffer overwrites, format assertions and uncleared mask planes without changing managed APIs. ([#5748](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5748))
